title: Summer Leadership Sync
description: Show of what we've accomplished this summer.

title: Weekly Meeting - Binary Exploitation
description: Hands-on binary exploitation workshop. We'll cover stack overflows, ROP chains, and how to use GDB effectively. Bring a laptop with a Linux VM or WSL set up.

title: Beginner Meeting - Linux Fundamentals
description: Introduction to the Linux command line for cybersecurity. We'll cover file navigation, permissions, processes, and basic scripting. No prior experience needed.

title: SummitCTF Planning Session
description: Planning meeting for the upcoming SummitCTF competition. We'll discuss challenge categories, infrastructure, and volunteer assignments.

title: Weekly Meeting - Web App Security
description: Deep dive into web application security: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and modern defenses. Live demo of Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP.

title: CTF Competition - picoCTF Kickoff
description: Kickoff event for picoCTF! We'll form teams, go over the rules, and start solving challenges together. Pizza provided.

title: Alumni Guest Speaker - Incident Response
description: CyberVT alumna Jane Smith (now at CrowdStrike) shares real-world incident response stories and career advice for breaking into the IR field.

title: Beginner Meeting - Cryptography Basics
description: Introduction to cryptography: symmetric vs asymmetric encryption, hashing, and common CTF crypto challenges. Hands-on with CyberChef and Python.
